intro: Choosing the right area matters more than the hotel itself in Koh Chang. Here are the main neighborhoods, who each suits, and where to book for your travel style.

blocks.html: Short answer: For a first visit stay at White Sand Beach (the main, liveliest beach with dining); for families or a quieter feel choose Klong Prao or Kai Bae; for backpackers and parties pick Lonely Beach; the far south at Bang Bao is the pier for boats to nearby islands.

faq.q: Which Koh Chang beach is best for a first visit?
faq.a: White Sand Beach is best for a first visit — the main beach with rooms for every budget, restaurants and shops, and easy access. Klong Prao and Kai Bae are quieter and better for families.

faq.q: Which Koh Chang beach is best for partying?
faq.a: Lonely Beach is Koh Chang’s backpacker and party area, with beach bars and cheap stays, lively at night — good for a younger crowd and tight budgets.

faq.q: Is Koh Chang good for families?
faq.a: Yes — especially Klong Prao and Kai Bae with their wide, quieter beaches and family-friendly resorts. White Sand Beach is convenient but busier.
